title: Seymour Papert 1983
summary: An eight-minute excerpt of a 1983 video featuring Seymour Papert, creator of Logo, on children learning programming and abstract ideas through embodied play. It shows kids acting out the Logo turtle.
why: Recommended to anyone unfamiliar with Papert as a glimpse of his vision for computers in education.

quote.text: One really powerful idea he had was ensuring that we stay "somatic" with our computer instruction
